_comment: Shared truth table for line pricing. Read by BOTH backend/src/lib/pricing.test.ts and frontend/src/pricing.test.ts, because those two implementations are hand-mirrored and nothing else forces them to agree. If they drift, the cart previews one number and the customer is charged another. Add a case here rather than to either test file alone.

cases.name: plain unit price with no discount
full sets plus remainder at full price
discountQty below 2 is not a real discount
half priced from halfPrice, not half of price
half never takes the bulk deal
full still takes the bulk deal on the same product
missing halfPrice charges full rather than nothing
omitted portion is treated as full

_feeComment: Add-on fees (hot water for instant noodles, and the like). Charged per unit, never discounted, and kept apart from the goods total so per-product revenue and fee income stay separately answerable.

feeCases.name: one unit at the default rate
charged per unit, not per line
